name: Mnemoverse
description: Hosted persistent memory for AI agents with shared rooms; tell it a recalled memory helped or misled and it re-ranks what comes back next. Free tier; OAuth on the hosted endpoint, API key for the npm package. Endpoint: `https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp` · Install: `npx -y @mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server@latest` · [Docs](https://mnemoverse.com/docs)
